Northrop Grumman is hiring an Associate Embedded Software Engineer for its Mission Systems team. The role develops embedded and real-time software for mission-critical applications, spanning software design, development, integration, and test in collaboration with multidisciplinary teams.

Responsibilities
This role contributes to the development of embedded and real-time software solutions for mission-critical applications, with responsibilities across software design, development, integration, and test
The position works closely with Systems Engineering, Digital Engineering, Hardware, and Integration & Test in a collaborative Agile environment
Help develop embedded software capabilities that support critical customer missions and operational needs
Contribute directly to the design, development, integration, debugging, and test of embedded and real-time software
Work closely with Systems Engineering, Digital Engineering, Hardware, and Integration & Test in an Agile environment
Help shape software solutions that connect customer needs, system intent, and implementation across multidisciplinary programs
